order Shop····
Hi support team,

I just received my nerd q miner and upon connecting it to power, i see that
it says connect to nerdaxe_68f1. when i connect to it via laptop, iphone,
or android tablet i just get a white screen no dashboard populates. when I
click off of the cap····portal and just open a chrome browser and type
192.168.4.1 i get the same white screen. I've also tried pressing the boot
button for 10 seconds, wait for the screen to say now safe to reboot and
wait for it to restart the miner i still get the same white screen. what
else can i try?
Handed to the team · Web UI fault I cannot resolve past the usual https/cache and reflash steps; need

Hi Jon,

Thanks for the detail, that helps. A blank white screen with the AP showing up normally is almost always the browser, not the miner. Chrome will quietly upgrade 192.168.4.1 to https, and the dashboard only serves plain http, so you get a white page. Type it out in full as http://192.168.4.1 and load it in an incognito window. On the phone or tablet, turn mobile data off first so it can't route around the miner's network.

If that still comes up blank, the next step is reflashing the firmware over USB from a computer, which clears a bad or half-written web interface. That fixes most units that boot and broadcast but won't serve the page.

I've also passed this to JD, who handles the hardware side, in case it's the flash chip rather than the browser. The team is offline now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and his answer comes straight to your email. If you'd rather not wait, he's on our Discord right now and that's the fastest route: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate.

Let me know which of the two steps you get to and what you see.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
